blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (Path traversal in read_attachment through the client-supplied name) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Validate `name` where it enters (CWE-22): reject it unless it equals `os.path.basename(name)` and is not empty, `.` or `..` — or better, look it up in the `attachments` table for that `ticket_id` and open only the stored name. Then resolve the path and check it stays under `os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, str(ticket_id))`. The authorization check on line 28 only covers the ticket, not the file the name reaches; `save_attachment` already applies `basename`, so the read side should be at least as strict.
findings.title: Path traversal in read_attachment through the client-supplied name

findings.evidence:
def save_attachment(ticket_id: int, filename: str, data: bytes) -> str:
    """Stores an uploaded file under the ticket's directory; returns its name."""
findings.recommendation: Take the agent's id like `read_attachment` does and check it may write to the ticket before touching the disk (CWE-862), so the check cannot be forgotten by a caller. The upload also silently overwrites an existing attachment of the same name on that ticket.
findings.title: save_attachment writes to any ticket without an authorization check
